fn:bind.cost: O(1) map lookup; at most 128 fields.
fn:bind.failure: BindingId/BindingLimit; the id must be 1..64 bytes, unique and free of NUL.

fn:bindLens.cost: O(1) plus one lens get or set and one parse per read or edit
fn:bindLens.failure: BindingId/BindingLimit; the lens and conversions run only when the field is read or edited.

fn:dirtyFields.cost: O(fields) reads of current and original; ids in bind order.

fn:edit.cost: one write call; O(1) plus the write function
fn:edit.failure: BindingUnknown; a write rejection is not an error of edit: it returns Ok(false) and the message is read by error.

fn:isDirty.cost: O(fields) reads of current and original

fn:pullFromForm.cost: O(fields) form lookups plus one edit per changed bound field
fn:pullFromForm.failure: propagates the error of text or edit; ids missing from the form are skipped.

fn:pushToForm.cost: O(fields) map lookups plus one setValue per bound field present in the form
fn:pushToForm.failure: GuiInvalidText from setValue; fields written before the failure keep their new text.

fn:redo.cost: O(1) plus one copy of the record

fn:text.cost: O(1) map lookup plus one read
fn:text.failure: BindingUnknown; an unknown id is an error and never returns an empty string.

fn:undo.cost: O(1) plus one copy of the record
